comparison.objective: Adjust a drill-press depth stop while holding a catch open, then verify repeat depth under two loads.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture adjustment, latch/catch manipulation, and force-loaded functional verification.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeat strokes stop near 10 mm under 8 N and 12 N and return between strokes; reported full-score depths are 10.09 and 10.15 mm.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual force control is generic; this task tests adjustable motion limiting and repeatability, not sacrificial notch fracture and free-fragment recovery.
